about.intro_content: Prof. Jun-Dong Li is Vice Director of the Department of Gynecologic Oncology at Sun Yat-sen University Cancer Center (SYSUCC), Guangzhou, specialising in gynecologic oncology with a focus on cervical and ovarian cancer.
about.detailed_content: Prof. Li has contributed to translational research on prognostic biomarkers in cervical cancer, including co-authored work on SPAG5 upregulation and its relationship to taxol treatment sensitivity via the mTOR signalling pathway. His clinical practice within SYSUCC's Department of Gynecologic Oncology covers diagnosis, surgery and systemic treatment planning for gynecologic malignancies.

faq.section_heading: Frequently Asked Questions About Prof. Jun-Dong Li

items.question: Does Prof. Jun-Dong Li accept international patients?
items.answer: CancerFax can coordinate medical report review and consultation support for international patients seeking an opinion related to cervical or ovarian cancer at Sun Yat-sen University Cancer Center, subject to hospital availability and case acceptance.

items.question: What is Prof. Li's area of specialisation?
items.answer: Prof. Li specialises in gynecologic oncology, with a clinical focus on cervical and ovarian cancer.

items.question: How can I request a consultation or second opinion?
items.answer: Submit your medical reports through CancerFax. The CancerFax team reviews the documents, prepares the case for submission, and coordinates next steps with SYSUCC's International Medical Center, subject to availability.

items.question: Has Prof. Li contributed to cervical cancer research?
items.answer: Yes. Prof. Li co-authored research identifying SPAG5 as a biomarker associated with poor prognosis and altered chemotherapy sensitivity in cervical cancer.

items.question: What role does Prof. Li hold at SYSUCC?
items.answer: Prof. Li serves as Vice Director of the Department of Gynecologic Oncology at SYSUCC.
